description: Get STOCK Act late filings -- trades whose disclosure was filed more than 45 days after the transaction, the latest the STOCK Act allows. A fact about the dates on the report: an extension, an amendment or a late notice of the trade can each explain a long gap, so never describe it as illegal or a violation. Sorted by filing delay descending. Excludes trades whose transaction date is suspect (a probable mistyped year upstream: ~one year off the rest of its own on-time filing) -- their delay is not measured. owner null means not stated, never "Self".
name: get_politician_late_filers
title: Get Politician Late Filers
